bagPolicy.summary: At Oklahoma State athletic events, clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. Backpacks are not allowed in Gallagher-Iba Arena.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Baby bags and medical bags in special situations
prohibited: Strollers, car seats and baby carriers
bagPolicy.note: Oklahoma State publishes this policy for ticketed athletic events. Concerts may set their own rules.

parking.summary: ADA parking in Lot 6 becomes available as early as 90 minutes before each game. Other lots require the credentials shown in the event parking plan.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands operate on the ground and mezzanine levels of Gallagher-Iba Arena.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: ADA parking is in Lot 6 and opens as early as 90 minutes before the game; the arena provides accessible seating and entry assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Athletics Center has a no-re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are distributed in the East Lobby to the authorized recipient with photo ID. Game-day north and south ticket windows open one hour before the event.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Athletics Center opens one hour before men’s basketball, women’s basketball, and wrestling events.
